tagline: Create Asana tasks from calendar events and block time for project work
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Asana Integration: Meeting Action Items
metaDescription: Create Asana prep tasks from calendar events and log action items after meetings. GAIA blocks time for milestones. See the setup steps.
intro:
Your Google Calendar tells you how time is allocated. Asana tells you what work needs doing. But most teams manage these separately — meetings get scheduled without corresponding prep tasks, deadlines exist without calendar time blocked to meet them, and project work suffers because schedule and task management don't inform each other.

GAIA makes the two work as a unified system. Meeting events generate prep and follow-up tasks. Task due dates create calendar reminders. Project milestones block calendar time for focused work. Your schedule and your task list finally tell the same story.

useCases.title: Meeting prep tasks from calendar events
useCases.description: For every calendar event with external attendees, GAIA creates a task to prepare for the meeting, review agenda, prepare talking points, assigned to the meeting host and due the day before.

useCases.title: Post-meeting action items in Asana
useCases.description: After calendar events end, GAIA creates a follow-up task to capture and distribute meeting notes and action items, ensuring meetings produce tracked outcomes.

useCases.title: Calendar blocks for project milestones
useCases.description: When a project milestone has a due date, GAIA creates a calendar reminder event so the deadline surfaces in your schedule with appropriate advance notice.

useCases.title: Deadline proximity alerts
useCases.description: GAIA monitors tasks and detects when deadlines are approaching on days that are heavily scheduled. It alerts you to reschedule meetings or extend deadlines proactively.

useCases.title: Recurring meeting to recurring task
useCases.description: Recurring calendar events like weekly standups or client check-ins generate recurring prep and follow-up tasks so standard meeting hygiene is always tracked.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your calendar and project accounts. Configure which projects receive tasks from which calendar event types.

howItWorks.step: Define task creation and time-blocking rules
howItWorks.description: Specify which meeting types generate prep tasks, how far in advance to create them, and which task due dates should create calendar reminders or time blocks.

howItWorks.step: GAIA aligns your schedule and task list
howItWorks.description: Calendar events and tasks stay in sync automatically. You plan and schedule in either tool and GAIA keeps both informed.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create Asana tasks for all calendar events or only specific types?
faqs.answer: You control which event types generate tasks. Common configurations include only events with external attendees, events tagged with specific calendars, or events lasting over 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Does GAIA update tasks if a calendar event is rescheduled?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a calendar event changes date or time, GAIA updates the due date on the corresponding prep task to match the new schedule.

faqs.question: Can GAIA help identify when deadlines conflict with a busy calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can audit your upcoming deadlines against your calendar and flag days where task deadlines and heavy meeting schedules conflict so you can plan accordingly.
